Included Features

Node-based Dialogue System

Create complex dialogues using an intuitive node-based editor. Connect conversation paths, add conditional logic, and manage character interactions with visual tools that make dialogue writing more accessible.

Main Menu

Pre-built main menu with customizable UI elements. Includes options for starting new games, loading saves, adjusting settings, and accessing additional game features with professional design.

Ready-to-use Save System

Complete save/load functionality with automatic and manual save options. Supports multiple save slots, quick save/load, and save state previews for better player experience.

Shaders

Specialized shaders for visual novel effects including screen transitions, character effects, lighting, and post-processing filters. Enhance the visual quality of your game with professional-grade rendering effects.

Customization

Extensive customization options for UI themes, character appearances, backgrounds, and game settings. Tailor every aspect of your visual novel to match your creative vision.

Addons & Plugin Extension

Extend functionality with modular addons and plugins. Add new features, integrate third-party services, or customize core systems without modifying the base engine code.

Cross-platform Input System

Unified input handling for mouse, keyboard, touch, and gamepad across all supported platforms. Ensures consistent player experience regardless of the device or platform used.

Easy Localization for Games

Built-in tools for translating games into multiple languages. Supports right-to-left languages, cultural adaptations, and easy management of localized content across different language versions.

Simple Audio system

Comprehensive audio management for background music, sound effects, and voice acting. Features volume controls, audio queuing, and seamless transitions between different audio tracks.
